weights.analysis: Attention QKV dominates absolute movement in layers one and three at 2.61 and 2.39.

effective_updates.analysis: Layer-one QKV also led actual optimizer displacement at .0344 per step compared with .0306 for layer three. These norms are measured weight differences.

tokens_and_objectives.analysis: Source-value occurrence gradient for word form is 1.52 versus .00075 for the practiced digit in its context. Controlled task-to-role embedding cosine is -.026.

representations.analysis: The force binding reader scarcely moved. L1.h0 matches a prior head with a negative runner-up margin, so identity stays uncertain. Paired digit and word gradient cosine fell from .988 to .407.

causal.analysis: Replacing layer-one source value now produces all 90 donor answers. Swapping the same written unit in its context produces zero donor answers. This localizes a value-dependent signal on the practiced path.

capabilities.analysis: The model gets 10/10 on practiced conversions and 5/10 on the changed frame.

failures.analysis: Word plus abbreviation scores 1/10, reverse 0/9, and the withheld value remains incorrect.

alternatives.analysis: A value-to-answer dictionary is consistent with the perfect value swap on one path. A reusable scale would have to support other values or directions too.

prediction.analysis: After a block with word and abbreviation variation, at least eight of the ten practiced values will work in the new style.

next_experiment.analysis: Expose styles within C01 and score C02 separately so the frame still tests transfer.

instruments.analysis: The occurrence trace localizes the large supervised error on the word value. A cross-route causal control is still needed to distinguish the raw number from the converted number.

decision.analysis: Introduce random digit or word and full or abbreviated units. Keep direction and question frame fixed for this block.

prior_predictions.analysis: The step-zero prediction of at least eight practiced answers is confirmed with ten.

prediction.statement: After a block with word and abbreviation variation, at least eight of the ten practiced values will work in the new style.
